title: AI prompts vs skills vs workflows: which one to use
seoTitle: AI prompts vs skills vs workflows explained
description: AI prompts vs skills, workflows, agents and specialists in plain words, with a decision table, a real example and prompts to pick the right one.
lede: Comparing AI prompts vs skills comes down to how much of a job you want to save for next time. A prompt is a single message, while a skill stores detailed instructions for a repeated job. A workflow connects several skills in sequence, and an agent works through the steps independently, using tools.
